title: Customer authentication and session management
problem_statement: Customers cannot securely access their own account, cart and order history without an authentication boundary; every authenticated storefront path depends on this, and credential handling must satisfy PDPA lawful basis and leak no PII.
why_now: Auth is the prerequisite for checkout, orders and reviews; nothing customer-specific can ship before it.
hypothesis: A short-lived access token plus a rotating refresh token gives a secure, low-friction session that unblocks the rest of the storefront.

success_criteria.metric: login success rate on valid credentials

tier_signals.evidence_quote: Register with email, password, name, phone. Email is unique; weak passwords rejected

tier_signals.signal: resolved PDPA lawful basis, no AML/sanctions
tier_signals.evidence_quote: Lawful basis cited to Thailand PDPA B.E. 2562 (2019)
